summary: Pick your target with Tab, lock it, and fire your skills on it — mobs, or enemy players in WoE.
about: Tab Target lists what you can hit around you and lets you pick it from the keyboard. On a normal map it shows the mobs, nearest first, those you can walk to above the others; a mob rare on its map gets a « rare » badge and a white cross on the minimap where it was last seen. In a castle during WoE the list switches by itself to the enemy players (outside your party, guild and allied guilds), then their homunculi, the guardians and the Emperium. Lock a target and nothing moves it until it dies: your skill keys 1-9 fire on it.

howto.text: lock or unlock the target; rebind it from the panel
cast the skill of F2 slots 1-9 on the target; Ctrl+digit keeps the game shortcut

needs: the ItemDb plugin (/pm), for the rare-mob badge
